title: 1 dead in police-involved shooting on Belt Parkway in Brooklyn
text:
Brooklyn police-involved shooting on Belt Parkway leaves 1 dead - ABC7 New York 
 24/7 Live New York City New Jersey Long Island Northern Suburbs Connecticut Brooklyn police-involved shooting leaves 1 dead on Belt Parkway 
 Sonia Rincon has the latest developments from Sheepshead Bay. By Eyewitness News Sunday, November 15, 2026 12:09PM Share SHEEPSHEAD BAY, Brooklyn (WABC) -- A man has died after a police-involved shooting in Brooklyn and a possible abduction on the Belt Parkway.
 Police say it started Saturday night just after 7.
 In a 9-1-1 call, two people reported seeing someone in a white cargo van, kicking and screaming, saying, "Let me go."
 Officers spotted the van on the Belt Parkway near Coney Island Avenue and tried to stop the driver.
 But the driver tried to escape, and that's when officers opened fire.
 "The driver began to drive forward and backward, ramming both police and occupied civilian vehicles," NYPD Assistant Chief Charles Minch said. "They used OC spray and deployed a taser, which was not effective, and the driver continued to ram nearby vehicles."
 The driver later died at a hospital.
 Police located the woman in the van; she's safe.
 Police say it was a domestic incident, and the driver was also wanted earlier this month for a domestic assault involving that same woman.
 Their identities have not been released.
